title: Brent sees a fatal motorcycle crash at age five

tellings.quote: when the back tire hits that water, her bike slides, stops, flips her, she goes

plain: A Hollywood writer named Brent Friedman told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about a memory from 1968, when he was five years old in the Berkeley Hills of California. He says he watched a woman on a motorcycle hit a patch of water with her back tire, slide, stop and get thrown, and that the crash killed her. He shares it as part of his own life story, a moment that stayed with him from early childhood.
